column1: I believe that people generally receive the outcomes they deserve.
I believe that people who meet with misfortune have often brought it on themselves.
I believe that people’s efforts are usually rewarded.
I believe that, by and large, people get what they deserve.
I feel that injustice is the exception rather than the rule.
I feel that people get what they are entitled to have.
I think basically the world is a just place.
